name: Angie's Restaurant Famous Giant Cinnamon Roll or Cinnamon Roll French Toast
whyItWorks: Made from pillowy soft white yeast dough with zero nuts or raisins; eating the warm center with scrambled eggs on the side slows down the sugar absorption.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Share a warm Cinnamon Roll (or order a half portion of Cinnamon Roll French Toast) alongside two scrambled eggs to buffer the sugar load, and scrape off excess icing.
watchOuts: High sugar and butter/frosting load—always pair with protein (eggs) and take lactase
